 Wpcrl No.1783 of 2025
 Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Vikram Singh Dhapola, learned counsel for the Petitioner.

2. Mr. S.S. Chauhan, learned DAG with Mr. Vikash Uniyal, learned Brief Holder, for the State of Uttarakhand/1 and 2.
3.

The present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India filed by the Petitioner for quashing/setting-aside the FIR No.305 of 2024, under Sections 420, 504 and 506 of IPC, at Police Station Kunda, District Udham Singh Nagar and directing the Respondent nos.1 and 2 not to arrest the Petitioner in connection with the abovementioned F.I.R.
4. Heard.
5. Admit.
6.
Issue notice to the Respondent No.3. Steps to be taken within a week.
Counter affidavit, if any, to be filed by the Respondents within a period of three weeks.

In the interregnum, it is directed that the investigation shall proceed but the present Petitioner shall not be arrested by the Police in pursuance to FIR No.305 of 2024, under Sections 420, 504 and 506 of IPC, at Police Station Kunda, District Udham Singh Nagar.

However, he will continue to cooperate with the Investigating Officer of the case and shall remain present before the Investigating Officer, as and when required for production of documents and for recording of his statements.

(Ashish Naithani, J.) 31.12.2025 Nitesh/
WPCRL/1783/2025 on 31 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8795143/
